name: a code change previews live before it ships
looks: A headline promises a look before anything goes live. A dark code editor sits fixed on one side showing a small file and the exact change being made, while a live preview of the real page updates on the other side in step with it, a pricing card visibly changing shape.
build: Both panels are fixed DOM content held side by side (ui-tilt-card's held-panel mechanic); the preview's layout change is cued to the same moment the code's edited line appears, no independent clock.
sound: A soft mechanical key tick under the code, a light pop as the preview updates.
prompt: Hold a dark code editor and a live page preview side by side; the instant a specific line changes in the code, have the preview update to match it, a card's shape or price shifting visibly, so a real edit and its real, live result read as one moment.
